author: EmanueleCoradin
body:
#### PR description:

`TensorCollection` now derives each tensors size from its SoA. The new `TensorSlice` selects batches independently for each tensor, allowing for more flexibility, which is important, for instance, for GNN models.

No change to the expected output of existing inference modules. The new example requires `TrackHitDeepSet.pt` in `cms-data/PhysicsTools-PyTorchAlpakaTest`:
https://github.com/cms-data/PhysicsTools-PyTorchAlpakaTest/pull/2

Thanks to @chrisizeh for reporting this need.

#### PR validation:

Updated the PyTorchAlpaka tests by adding `TrackHitDeepSet` to test for this new feature.
title: Introduce TensorSlice
